name: Hathath
overview: Hathath is a male member of the tribe of Judah known primarily as the son of Othniel, as recorded in 1 Chronicles 4:13. Beyond this familial connection, Scripture provides no additional details or notable events concerning his life. His mention serves to preserve genealogical records within the tribe of Judah.
namesAndTitles: The name Hathath is a proper name that may mean either 'terror' or 'weakness,' though it is not indicated that this name was given by God. The biblical text offers no further titles or designations for Hathath.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Hathath as the son of Othniel, establishing a direct paternal relationship. No other family relationships are noted beyond this connection in the biblical record.
scriptureSignificance: Hathath's primary significance lies in his genealogical placement within the tribe of Judah as the son of Othniel. This connection situates him within the broader biblical narrative of God's chosen people, emphasizing the continuity of the tribe through successive generations. While no specific deeds or roles are attributed to him, his mention underscores the importance of lineage in God's providential plan.
